headline: Trump calls Asia trip a success, with few concrete results
pages: President Trump told reporters at the White House on Friday that his Asia trip, which included a meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin, was a resounding success. NPR reports the trip produced mostly agreements to keep talking. The meeting with both leaders, described as historic, ended only with an agreement to continue discussing ways to reduce nuclear risks. In Manila, Trump signed a trade agreement with Thailand, but the document marks only a "substantial conclusion" to negotiations. Trump also said he and Xi agreed to set up joint guardrails on artificial intelligence, with no detail on what they would cover or when.
That is a shift for Trump, who has argued that regulating AI would hurt US innovation. The guardrails are the one new policy to come out of the trip. Source: NPR
